hook_stat.sub: Fee USCIS is not collecting on H-1B petitions for workers outside the United States

news_summary: USCIS has started approving H-1B petitions for workers outside the United States without collecting the $100,000 fee, after weeks in which premium-processing cases sat past their 15-business-day deadline.
payoff: The government has appealed in both the First and Ninth Circuits, and USCIS says it will collect the fee if the court orders are lifted.

stats.label: Premium-processing deadline that stalled petitions sat past with no decision
